subject: Urgent: launch-week burst top-up and invoicing path
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch week capacity — possible short-notice top-up?

Hi Marcus,

We’re ramping to a hard launch next Friday (6/5) and we’re seeing forecasted token consumption that exceeds our committed quota for a 48-hour peak window. Can Redwood confirm: 1) whether we can get temporary headroom for the 6/4–6/6 window, and 2) what the overrun / on-demand rate would look like if we don’t prepay?

Key details: expected 48-hour peak, ~5M extra tokens, latency sensitivity to 150ms p95. We need an answer today to update our launch runbook.

If there’s a quick priced option (one-off top-up / prepay vs hourly burst surcharge), please send numbers + PO flow. If a short-term contract amendment is needed, loop legal — but we’d prefer a pragmatic, invoiceable path.

Thanks —
Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of ML Products, FastRetail
procurement@fastretail.com


From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-01T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — possible short-notice top-up?

Lisa —

Short answer: yes, we can cover a 48-hour burst. Two pragmatic paths depending on FastRetail’s preference:

Option A — Prepaid top-up (recommended for predictability)
- One-off prepaid token bucket: 5M tokens at a discounted add-on rate.
- Immediate activation on receipt of PO + acknowledgment.
- Pricing in attached "burst_pricing_options_v1.pdf" and provisional quote sheet.

Option B — On-demand overrun (fast, no PO upfront)
- Overage billed at our short-window overrun rate (list rate + 40% uplift for instant capacity).
- No invoice delay required but higher unit price; good if ops needs speed.

Operational notes: we can pin the model variant and reserve ephemeral capacity to maintain your p95 latency target (150ms) for the 48-hour window. That does require an activation window of ~2 hours before the spike.

If you’re able to do a PO today, we’ll accept a PO to marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com and can turn the prepaid bucket on immediately after confirmation from our finance team. For legal, we can offer a short addendum (one paragraph) to cover the temporary bucket and invoicing terms — Ben, can you confirm acceptance and typical lead time for PO processing?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: burst_pricing_options_v1.pdf, FR-331-provisional-quote.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — possible short-notice top-up?

Marcus/Lisa —

I pulled the numbers and carved a provisional price table into the attached quote sheet. High-level:
- Prepay 5M tokens: unit price $0.0009/token (net), total $4,500. Payment terms: net 30; we can provision on PO receipt or advance payment.
- On-demand overrun: $0.00126/token (25% premium on list for short-window overrun).
- Escrowed headroom option: we can receive a short-term retainer (50% of prepay) that holds capacity; remainder invoiced post-window. Good if procurement needs lower net cash outlay.

For the PO path: if FastRetail can send a PO to accounts@redwoodinference.com with FR-331 referenced, we’ll route to Finance for same-day provisioning. For legal addendum: we typically use a one-page SOW amendment — turnaround is ~24–48 hours depending on redlines.

If we need to accelerate activation before PO clears, we can provision immediately and mark as provisional with a credit hold; however, that requires a written approval from an authorized FastRetail signer (email OK).

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: FR-331-provisional-quote.xlsx

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: 2026-06-03T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week capacity — possible short-notice top-up?

Ben/Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. FastRetail will take Option A with the escrow-retainer path: we will issue a PO for the 50% retainer today referencing FR-331 and the provisional quote. Please provision the 5M token bucket as provisional on activation after the PO is received; we’ll complete payment within net 30.

One ask: can Redwood include a one-paragraph addendum referencing temporary headroom dates (6/4 00:00 PT — 6/6 23:59 PT) and that unused tokens will be credited back at the prepay rate within 10 business days after the window? Procurement will need that language in the invoice or backup to approve the PO.

If you can send the addendum PDF and the final PO line items, we’ll route the PO and confirm.

Appreciate the help — this launch is critical for us.

—Lisa
Lisa Tran
Head of ML Products, FastRetail
procurement@fastretail.com
